title: C29-A Strict Temporal Out-of-Sample Holdout on the Newest Never-Scored Window
why_c29: C24 established margin/liquidation fidelity (PASS, consolidated C24_REOPENS_C1_C23). C25/C26 adjudicate cost/funding and intrabar-path fidelity on 4 venues x 4 folds (2023-2026YTD). C27 is next-venue replication. C28 is portfolio-level cross-venue capital allocation & correlation fidelity. C29-A is the mandatory same-session successor on C28 ACCEPTANCE: PASS: it opens the strict temporal out-of-sample holdout frontier — the pooled sign on a holdout window that no C1-C28 cell has ever scored. No holdout direction has yet been scored; C29-A closes that gap so the heavy-work queue never dries out and no session may claim 'no authorized work'. C29 may NOT launch until C28 ACCEPTANCE: PASS; C28 on C27; C27 on C26; C26 on C25; C25 IN FLIGHT.
research_question: Does the pooled spec-literal crash-rebound edge remain positive under the strict_temporal_oos_holdout fidelity axis, across four real venues, when scored on a strict temporal holdout window (newest never-scored real data) with the signal path frozen and draw floors intact?
blocked_on: C28-T1 (portfolio-level cross-venue capital allocation & correlation fidelity), which is blocked on C27, which is blocked on C26, which is blocked on C25. C29 build (this prereg) may proceed before C25/C26/C27/C28 pass, but no C29 cell may run until C28 ACCEPTANCE: PASS and the C28 primary-arm evidence is available as anchor reference.

signal_path_frozen.drift_rule: Any artifact whose signal_path/cost/execution fields differ from this prereg are INVALID.

holdout_base.why: C25/C26 primary-arm model re-run on the holdout window; must reproduce the established per-venue baseline within +/-1.0 (HOLDOUT_ANCHOR_REPRODUCED). Baseline for the holdout direction.

holdout_primary.why: Strict temporal OOS holdout on never-scored real data (the newest window no C1-C28 cell has scored). Pooled sign and CI95 on the holdout window decide whether the edge generalizes forward in time.

liquidation.rule: Liquidation distance fixed at the C24 primary arm (d15: maint=14, buffer=1 => 15%); not a C29 variable.

arms_rule: ONLY the C29 direction axis varies across arms. All other config fields (signal path + liquidation distance + cost model + funding model) are identical and drift-checked. The FIDELITY_ANCHOR arm reproduces the prior primary-arm baseline within +/-1.0; the PRIMARY arm is the adjudication arm. All arms run the full 4 venues x 4 folds x 20k bootstrap / 20k permutation / 2k placebo — no smoke arm, no reduced draw floors, no descriptive-only arm.

inference.pooled: venue-blocked bootstrap over the venue-fold cell totals (20000 draws)

multiplicity.family: primary arm, 4 folds x 4 venues = 16 permutation tests

inference.power_floor: >= 10 trades / >= 5 episodes / >= 5 distinct crash days per fold; otherwise UNDERPOWERED with a power curve.

funding_acquisition.rule: A venue without realized funding history is recorded UNAVAILABLE_FUNDING (never zero-filled) and the realistic arms are evaluated on the remaining venues; okx is UNAVAILABLE_FUNDING by API retention (33-day window).

anchor_rule.rule: Anchor verification against the prior primary arm is mandatory BEFORE any C29 inference cell runs. The fidelity-anchor arm of the selected direction must reproduce the C28 primary-arm per-venue/per-fold PnL (or the corresponding C29-A baseline) within +/-1.0 (HOLDOUT_ANCHOR_REPRODUCED). Anchor mismatch => C29_UNDERPOWERED; no verdict may be issued until the anchor reproduces.

decision_rules.C29_REOPENS_C1_C28: ALL of, under the PRIMARY arm of the selected direction: (a) pooled total PnL > 0; (b) venue-blocked bootstrap CI95 lower bound > 0; (c) >= 1 BH survivor in the 16-test primary-arm family; (d) >= 3 of 4 folds positive; (e) >= 3 of 4 venues positive (available venue set). Then the C1-C28 NO_GO is NOT robust to the C29 fidelity axis: record SUPERSEDED_BY_C29 and the edge is re-opened.
decision_rules.C29_NO_GO_ROBUST_TO_HOLDOUT: ANY of (a)-(e) fails under the PRIMARY arm. Then the NO_GO survives the C29 fidelity axis and is strengthened: record C1-C29 NO_GO ROBUST TO MARGIN, COST, PATH, ALLOCATION AND HOLDOUT.
C29_UNDERPOWERED: Anchor mismatch, prereg generated after any compute artifact, draw floors not met, missing artifacts, signal-path/cost/execution drift, or acquisition gate not passed.

checkpoint_rule: A (direction, arm, venue, fold) is DONE only when research_state/c29_ckpt_<direction>_<arm>_<venue>_<fold>_<TS>.json exists. Resume with --resume; never relaunch completed folds.

provenance.caveat: Real exchange USDT-perp data, non-synthetic, CROSS-VENUE vs the Hyperliquid spec; NEVER Hyperliquid performance evidence and never relabelled as such.

guardrails: No synthetic gap-fill; no spec relaxation of RSI/target/hold/sizing/volume/gross cap.

Signal path frozen to the C24/C25/C26 sentinel; liquidation distance fixed at the C24 primary d15; cost model frozen at C25 primary; funding model honest (okx = UNAVAILABLE_FUNDING, never zero-filled or proxied).
No additional venues, folds, or directions beyond those pre-registered for the selected C29 direction.
Artifacts are immutable once written; do not edit completed campaign outputs.
No C29 cell runs until C28 ACCEPTANCE: PASS (sequential adjudication chain).
Draw floors (20k/20k/2k/2k) are not reducible. No reduced-draw runs.
No same-data rerun of a closed campaign; C29-A needs a new data manifest (strict temporal holdout window) + fresh prereg + anchor verification.
